item.title: Arkansas Game and Fish Commission Archery in the Schools State Championship set for March
item.description: The Arkansas Game and Fish Commission's Archery in the Schools State Championship will take place on March 6 & 7 at the Hot Springs Convention Center and Bank OZK Arena, with the top three teams in each age group receiving medals and team trophies, and the top individual boy and girl in each age group receiving a Mathews Genesis bow and college scholarship money.

item.title: Back in Business: West Ouachita Chiefs breaks barrier to return back to LHSAA Playoffs
item.description: CADEVILLE, La. (KTVE/KARD) —For the first time since 2019—the West Ouachita Chiefs are playing postseason basketball. The Chiefs finished the regular season with a 15-17 record—earning them the 27-seed. It is a goal they set from day one and now—they are ready to jump back into the madness.
